selected_problem: Fresh-main truth-boundary discovery can re-promote an older UNRESOLVED row after newer main-line evidence has already closed that exact boundary, because revision freshness orders evidence but carries no explicit row-level closure relation. After PR #69 closed the direct-merge expected-base gap recorded by PR #68, the current bridge can still treat PR #68 truth_boundaries[0] as actionable.

execution.route_basis: Fresh revision ordering exposes a portfolio of historical truth boundaries in one diagnosis domain; the stale closed row is itself evidence that boundary history lacks a closure relation, while the wider unresolved portfolio keeps artifact pressure high. The committed four-mode router therefore routes this source-contract replay to WHOLE_ARTIFACT without forced mode rotation.

resolves.reason: Closed by PR #69 / canonical main a3171eb0a3a1e11e4ac1f4fe7518b544a571339f: direct and canonical GitHub merge entry points now require or derive expected base identity before a valid merge can proceed.

changes: Evidence files may now carry explicit `resolves` references keyed by stable source path plus boundary path; no product feature list or semantic guesswork is introduced.
A resolution is applied only while scanning older evidence, so historical resolution records cannot erase a newer boundary revision.
Resolved historical rows are removed before the 96-row observation budget and before candidate severity ranking, preventing closed work from consuming diagnosis capacity.
PR #68's obsolete direct-merge-base UNRESOLVED row is explicitly resolved by this evidence because PR #69 closed that exact gap.

validation.pre_fix_reproduction: REPRODUCED: the unpatched bridge selected `UNRESOLVED: legacy direct merge base binding is missing` even though a newer committed evidence file explicitly resolved that exact source/path.

truth_boundaries: Explicit resolution references suppress only older boundary rows identified by source plus path; no semantic inference or hard-coded implementation roadmap is introduced.
A committed resolution record is provenance for diagnosis state, not proof that arbitrary uncited historical boundaries are closed.
BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: GitHub's merge REST endpoint still lacks an atomic expected-base-SHA precondition, so external GET-to-PUT base races remain outside client-side elimination.
